review:
Chests of Cai Shen is a 5x3 Chinese luck slot with green, red and purple coins. Each coin goes into a matching chest above the reels, which grows and increases the chance of its bonus.

Landing at least six coins of one colour can trigger that chest's Hold & Spin bonus, and each chest has its own variant, which can work alone or combined. The green chest can upgrade up to three coin values, for example. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.57%. Three chests means plenty of variety in the bonus.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
